title: Rabbi Nezira
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Bereshit Rabbah 12:6 mentions Rabbi Levi reporting him. At 11:2 the name is given as Rabbi Zeira; Hyman calls this an error and proposes Rabbi Nezira.

Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:5, the end of Bereshit Rabbah chapter 82 and Midrash Tehillim 92:4 have Rabbi Levi reporting Rabbi Nezira. Hyman proposes the same reading at the end of Shekalim chapter 2.
And we find Rabbi Shimon bar Nezira, Shabbat 33b.

notes.text: The locator ספפ״ב denotes the end of chapter 82, not chapter 2. Hyman’s correction of Zeira to Nezira is retained as his proposal.

The consulted Bereshit Rabbah 12:6 has Levi in Nezira’s name; 11:2 has Levi in Zeira’s name in the parallel light tradition. Hyman’s proposed correction is retained as his proposal, with both consulted forms distinguished.
